cases.text: A note-taking assistant maintains long-lived conversational memory while worker sessions execute delegated tasks. Memory is captured as typed records, embedded into a vector index, and recalled into constructed context when a new turn arrives. The quality of that recall depends directly on the fidelity of the embedding engine, which is why parity between inference stacks is treated as a release gate rather than a nicety.
